statistic.kill_stat: median retention of naive_mutable over turns >= 3

metric_caveat: Self-normalised retention (cached/cached_max) is the pre-registered kill statistic, but an arm whose cached tokens are a small CONSTANT floor scores retention=1.0 forever. Read it against absolute_retention_by_window and absolute_share_of_last_prompt, which are on the same scale for all arms.
